root_cause: normalizeObservabilityRecord in portal-v2/runtime-evidence.js never emitted a traceId, while the Agent Intelligence quality report counts events by e.traceId. The row 'Agents & tracekwaliteit' was therefore structurally NIET GEMETEN, even when the server records carried trace_id or traceId.
prevention_rule: A metric that reads a field must have a regression test from the source record through the normalizer to the report. Only an explicit traceId or trace_id counts as a trace; correlationId is a loop identifier and never becomes a trace.
supersedes_status_of: brain/learning/2026-10-23-portal-agent-intelligence-evidence-analytics-v1.json (its status IMPLEMENTED_ON_FEATURE_BRANCH_NOT_LIVE is outdated: #4747, #4761 and #4777 are merged on main since 2026-10-23; production readback is still not independently verified)

invariants: explicit traceId or trace_id is kept and trimmed
correlationId is never promoted to a trace
an observed trace is not a trace grade or quality proof
no new scheduler, endpoint, writer or source authority
